title: Savior, I Follow on
description: Savior, I Follow on in Tonic Solfa to ST. EDMUND (SULLIVAN), doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Charles Seymour Robinson wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 337.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked 6.4.6.4.6.6.6.4, to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. EDMUND (SULLIVAN); any other 6.4.6.4.6.6.6.4 tune fits them as well.
underlay: Sa-vior, I fol-low on, Guid-ed by Thee, See-ing not yet the hand That lead-eth me. Hushed be my heart and still, Fear I no fur-ther ill, On-ly to meet Thy will_ My will shall be.

lines: Hushed be my heart and still,

licence: Public domain: Charles Seymour Robinson died in 1899.
credits: Words by Charles Seymour Robinson (1829–1899), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to ST. EDMUND (SULLIVAN) by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
